title: Watch Dogs
shortDescription: Watch Dogs helps define a Wii U action and adventure path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Keeps a documented action and adventure option visible in the Wii U collection.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Logged for the Wii U action and adventure discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
